mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary tightening, which raises discount rates for equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5%, it triggers aggressive monetary policy tightening that compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.5), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates an overheating economy that forces aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a further decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness that precedes inflationary pressures and Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion with declining UNRATE, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates weakening supply conditions and economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.6 million units, it signals excessive demand in the housing sector that triggers Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1600.0), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1.5 million units indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as market expectations for prolonged weakness intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market weakness that precedes economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
